message.content: The illustration shows a large round man in a blue shirt and tan trousers standing on a sandy-colored surface. He holds the edge of a dark gray asphalt road, pulling it upward and rolling it back like a flexible carpet. The road, which features white dashed lines, curves from the bottom of the frame toward the man. A blue three-wheeled vehicle with a dark gray roof is positioned on the road, facing away from the viewer. The vehicle has a license plate reading "R I D O". Two people are visible inside the vehicle; one person’s arm and head are visible on the left side, and another person’s head wearing a black cap is visible on the right. In the background, white classical columns stand on a tiered base. Above, large red letters spell "TEMPO." Below this, black text reads "Kalah, Mah, Kalah Aja," "Pembiayaan Transisi Energi yang Mandek H.78," and "Pelindung Sahbirin Noor di KPK H.66." A barcode and a QR code are located in the bottom-left corner.
